    max_length = -1
    
    # Check all possible lengths of the substring P
    for length in range(1, n + 1):
        for i in range(n - length + 1):
            P = S[i:i + length]
            prefix = S[:length]
            suffix = S[-length:]
            
            # Check if P is a substring of S

                if not (P == prefix or P == suffix):

                    break  # No need to check further lengths
